title: Campervan vs Rental Car for NZ Family Road Trips — The Real Comparison
meta_desc: Compare campervan vs rental car for NZ family road trips, including costs, flexibility, and what you give up with each option
intro: When planning a family road trip in New Zealand, one of the most significant decisions is whether to rent a campervan or a car. With a 10-day road trip from Auckland to Rotorua and back costing upwards of $2,000 in fuel and accommodation alone, it pays to make the right choice. Here's a breakdown of the costs and benefits of each option to help you decide

sections.heading: Flexibility and Freedom
sections.body: One of the main advantages of a campervan is the flexibility to stop and camp wherever you like, without being tied to a specific accommodation booking. However, this freedom comes at a cost, with campervans often having limited kitchen and bathroom facilities. In contrast, rental cars offer the freedom to explore without the burden of a large vehicle, but require more planning and booking of accommodation in advance.

sections.heading: What You Give Up
list: Campervan: luxury and space, with smaller beds and limited amenities
Rental Car: flexibility and freedom to camp wherever you like, with the need to book accommodation in advance

sections.heading: Drive Times and Distances
sections.body: New Zealand's scenic routes can be long and winding, with drive times often taking longer than expected. For example, the drive from Auckland to Rotorua takes around 3 hours, while the drive from Rotorua to Wellington takes around 5.5 hours. Be sure to factor in rest stops and sightseeing time when planning your itinerary.

sections.heading: Real-World Example
sections.body: Let's say you're planning a 10-day road trip from Auckland to Rotorua, Taupo, and Wellington, with a family of four. A campervan rental from a company like Jucy or Britz would cost around $1,200, plus $200 in fuel. In contrast, a rental car from a company like Europcar or Hertz would cost around $400, plus $1,000 in accommodation costs. Add in food and activities, and the total cost of the trip would be around $2,500 for the campervan option, or $2,800 for the rental car option.
